title: Algiers expedition (1519)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Algiers expedition (1519)", at revision 1370427887, opens: "In 1519, a joint Spanish-Italian attack on Algiers was ordered by Charles V and commanded by Hugo of Moncada. The attack was repelled by the Algerians led by Hayreddin Barbarossa." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q108542187, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1518 joint Spanish-Italian attack on Algiers". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
